items.title: 'Perfect ball' | Nygren nods Celtic in front from Tierney's superb delivery
items.description: Benjamin Nygren scores Celtic's first goal of the season with a header from a great cross from Kieran Tierney to give the home side the lead against Dundee.

items.title: Eala beats Pegula at DC Open to claim first WTA Tour title
